_comment: Maps a tileset's base filename (no directory, no .json) to an ordered list of prop names cycled around an exterior map's outer ring by GameScene::decorateMapEdges() - gives every exterior map the impression of a horizon at its border instead of just stopping. A tileset with no entry here gets no auto-border (safe no-op) - lets this roll out tileset-by-tileset. Real wide panoramic horizon art (2026-09-09, from tileset_props_borders_walls.md) - each is a ~3:1 landscape strip calibrated to 576px wide (9 tiles) so 2-3 side by side cover a full map edge without an obvious repeat.
